'''Wraith Two''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the second member of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Wraith Squadron]],<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> the [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] of the squadron [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|leader]]. By policy of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], the position was often assigned to a rookie pilot in need of additional instruction or protection.<ref name="Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>

==History==
Following the adoption of the "Wraith" designation by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Wraith Squadron|Gray Squadron]], [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] communications specialist [[Jesmin Ackbar]] was the first [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to serve under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]], participating in the [[Battle of Folor|evacuation of Folor]] and [[Mission to Xartun|raids]] on [[Xartun]] and [[Blood Nest]], the latter of which resulted in [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Death/Legends|death]] in a crash on the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] surface.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

[[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Castin Donn]] took Ackbar's place as Wraith Two during Wraith Squadron's [[Halmad campaign|campaign]] posing as a [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force|pirate force]], until he was killed during an unsanctioned infiltration of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']],<ref name="Iron Fist" /> after which his position was filled by fellow Wraith and erstwhile [[Zsinj's Empire|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Gara Petothel]], in the identity of "[[Lara Notsil]]."<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>

By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the Wraiths were reformed by [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]] [[Garik Loran]] to prove the corrupt activities of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. [[Wraith One]] [[Bhindi Drayson]] was assigned to lead the team, while the Wraith Two call sign was assigned to [[Turman Durra]], a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Actor/Legends|actor]].<ref name="MK" />

Unbeknownst to Drayson's team, Loran also secretly formed a second unit of Wraiths under Wraith veteran [[Sharr Latt]]. The second unit's Wraith Two call sign was assigned to [[Wran Narcassan]], a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] and hand-to-hand fighter. He was also the nephew of [[Shalla Nelprin]], who previously served in Wraith Squadron.<ref name="MK" />
